summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Place sims assemble local spaces and hazards around shared player, NPC, loot, crafting, combat, animation and UI systems; paired level-door markers connect the explored routes, including the Level 2.1 bridge to Level 8.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, shifting walls and hunters.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Utility Halls and Locked sublevel; Level 2 sim dresses its shutter stair, and Level 2.1 builds Base Alef, Refrigerator Paradise, The Edges, survivors, hounds and Smilers.
places/level3 + places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators, lifts and checkpoint.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; office plan, residents, cubicles, fountains, vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega.
places/level5 + places/level6 (3D) - Terror Hotel and Lights Out; Level 5 rooms, quests and portal; Level 6 dark labyrinth and sensory hazards.
places/level7 (3D) - Thalassophobia; flooded Floating House, Seawatch, Fort Surrender, sea floor, diving bell and Level 9 hatch.
places/level8 (3D) - Cave Systems / 9th Road; colliding cave, entrance lake, flood cavern, spiders, tar dredge, survivor camp and route toward Level 9; Carla and camp NPCs are modeled survivors.
places/debug (3D) - Debug room; separate dark atmosphere and spawn.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, player template and HUD; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/player controller precede swim, interaction and gameplay handlers, then critter, main-menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and authored placements; sims construct local layouts and tick local behavior, respawns and regrowth.
sim.js - world referee cadence plus onOutOfBounds; players keep normal respawn, creatures return to state.home or are destroyed for manager respawn.
places/level8/sim.js + art/level8/build.py - Level 8 assembler and Blender cave-road generator; cave material is scripts/mat-cave.js.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays, including menu/creator, wardrobe, loot, talk/trade, build, stats, craft and OS.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local player menu and Continue/Character actions; hides the player and supplies the menu camera backdrop.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; scripts/lib/body3.js provides weapon animation and rowing IK.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js + data - per-level grids, zones and layouts used by simulations, geometry, player zone labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level3.js, level4.js, level5.js, level6.js + path helpers - level plans, zone/route queries and navigation reused by place systems and creatures.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.
scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + model/face data, scripts/mat-cloth.js - seeded avatar/NPC looks and rendered critter bodies and garments.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js; art/props/build.py - shared item pools, rolls, remains and container helpers/models reused across the maze and Level 2.1.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml; scripts/lib/personality.js + scripts/lib/address.js - recipes, NPC temperament and address rules reused by actions, UI and dialogue.

scripts/ambient-anim.js + scripts/lib/ambient.js - tweened prop spin/sway/pulse/creak and FX builders reused by Levels 2.1 and 8; scripts/lib/chatter.js + chatter.yml supplies place NPC exchanges and voice mappings.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level8/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects.
scripts/lib/level21.js - grid, room, zone, exit and height queries/constants; scripts/lib/maze21path.js - canPass21, stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/l21-use.js - updateSchedule, ears, update; scripts/level21-geo.js - geometry; scripts/lib/chatter.js - tickChatter, CHATTER.
scripts/l8-life.js - updateSchedule, update; scripts/l8-use.js - ears, onTriggerEnter, back.
scripts/soup-slick.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf and shared loot/remains/container helpers; scripts/lib/items.js - item parsing and descriptions.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js - keepPeople, every, RESPAWN_MS; scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - RESPAWN_MS, mayReturn, firstLay; scripts/terrain7.js - ISLES, heightAt, materialAt.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs and heat, money, visits, kills/deaths, combat, rewards and look/clothing data.
scripts/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version and sheet state; initializes/migrates and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - craft UI/actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; Level 2.1 hot/humid thirst multiplier comes from level21.yml.
scripts/swim.js - player.state swimming/underwater/breath and local session swim controls, breath timer and underwater audio instance; applies drowning damage.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js own focus, loot and sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns pick state and pins; seats own occupancy.
scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC dialogue memory/rapport/shop/follow state; meg-agent owns routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear and cover.
places/level21/sim.js - place build/people versions, survivor placement and hound manager; scripts/l21-use.js owns prop cooldowns, payouts/quests, survivor talk UI and Edge Smiler management.

places/level8/sim.js owns build version, camp setup and shared regrow deadlines; l8-life.js owns local hazard/boss timing; l8-use.js writes player payouts, quest flags and route progress; ambient-anim.js starts prop tweens from state.anim.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; menu hides player and supplies ctx.view.camera backdrop.
engine out-of-bounds event → sim.js onOutOfBounds: player returns true for normal respawn; creature with state.home is repositioned there, otherwise destroyed for its manager to respawn.
Level 2 shutter/stair → places/level2/sim.js paired l2-to-l21 door → scripts/level-door.js crosses to level21#l21-from-l2; stairDress builds its lamps, rail, pipes, tube and sign.
places/level21/sim.js → scripts/lib/level21.js layout and scripts/level21-geo.js geometry; hounds.js uses maze21path.js for pursuit; l21-use.js handles set pieces and Edge Smilers.
Level 2.1 and Level 8 sim props carry state.anim → scripts/ambient-anim.js → builtin/tween; ambient.js supplies fan/cable meshes and DRIP/DUST/MIST/RIPPLE FX.

places/level21/sim.js tick → chatter.js with CHATTER.level21 and voice IDs → survivor agents emit voiced nearby exchanges; NPC usable props in l21-use.js update CRT logs, player payouts and local feedback events.
player zone/sanity and thirst → level21.js zoneAt + level21.yml drains/heat; craft.js applies the hot-humid thirst multiplier.

scripts/swim.js queries tagged swimwater volumes in Level 8 → adjusts local movement, breath and drowning; underwater state tints HUD in scripts/ui.js and starts scripts/underwater-audio.js on Master.
places/level7/sim.js diving bell ↔ Level 8 lake-bed trigger; Level 8's Level 2.1 tunnel and Level 2.1 cave mouth use paired level-door arrival markers.

interact.js on NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits choices/text/trade → talk.js and NPC ears; dialogue stores per-player memory/rapport and follow intent feeds meg-agent.js; player.js payouts/xfer → craft.js and scripts/ui.js, while Level 8 use/life systems manage regrowth and hazards.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures, local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 cells also carry portal and quest props.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look scripts - office structure, details and varied props share the office plan; Level 7 has dedicated room/ocean geometry.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe, including Level 8 cave materials.

places/level8/sim.js + scripts/l8-life.js + scripts/l8-use.js - coordinate-interpolated road stations share systems while hazards, harvests, caches, camp interactions, quests and payouts vary by station.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot placement vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.
scripts/lib/ambient.js + scripts/ambient-anim.js - fan, cable, lamp, web, fungus and cocoon motions/FX reuse builders and animation kinds, varied by position, phase, period and effect.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal and sim geometry/hound routing aligned; its rebuild V is 10.
Keep paired arrival IDs: Level 2 ↔ Level 2.1 (l2-from-l21/l21-from-l2), Level 2.1 ↔ Level 8 (l21-from-l8/l8-from-l21); player.js CHECKS consumes these markers for respawn checkpoints.
Level 2.1 rebuilt fixtures/ambience are sim-managed; its peopleV reset replaces survivor agents, and roofAt belongs in place state so the ceiling check survives tick calls.

Level 2.1 zone keys are suffixes of zoneAt values and index level21.yml sanityDrain; hot/humid thirst multiplier is level21.yml heat applied in craft.js. Keep zone names aligned across consumers, including player heat and floor selection.
Creature remains from scripts/lib/loot.js persist for 3600 seconds; soup bowls live as soup_bowl and 30 s soupslick puddles link player movement, NPC/hostile staggering and Level 8 spider behavior.
Level 8 lake return trigger is at the lake bed's middle, not the wading surface; swim.js relies on bounds of tagged swimwater volumes and runs after player.js to override movement/falling.
